description: This Java class defines a property editor for PersonAttributeType objects in the OpenMRS framework, enabling serialization and deserialization for form processing and object retrieval by ID or UUID.

classes.name: PersonAttributeTypeEditor
classes.description: A property editor that handles conversion of PersonAttributeType objects to and from string representations, supporting ID and UUID-based retrieval.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttributeType object using its integer ID via the OpenMRS PersonService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttributeType object using its UUID string via the OpenMRS PersonService.
